portion_doctrine: Segments 61-70 contain 5 major frameworks extracted from video course transcripts: (1) Script Writing 5-Step Framework (Psychology > Packaging > Outline > Intro > Body > Outro), (2) First 10 Pages screenplay principles, (3) 48-hour screenplay writing sprint methodology, (4) Automation workflow (Nan + Sora + Google Sheets + webhooks), and (5) AlphaGo AI strategy documentary. Content is 70% tactical video course material, 15% screenplay craft examples, 15% technical automation tutorials. Boilerplate/timestamps stripped. Real operative content: frameworks, numbered steps, specific tactics, psychology principles.
operating_rules: Expectations vs Reality: Core psychology principle - reality beating expectations drives engagement (applies to all content)
Click Confirmation: First lines of intro must confirm/exceed title expectations
Measure Twice, Cut Once: Complete idea/title/outline BEFORE writing intro (order: Packaging > Outline > Intro > Body > Outro)
Unique or Die: Every outline point must be novel/differentiated - don't regurgitate existing knowledge
What/Why/How layering: For each outline point, establish what it is, why it matters, how it fits the story
First Point Blows Mind: Body's opening must be so compelling it creates gap between expectations and reality
Native Embedding (CTA Integration): Integrate calls-to-action by framing pain + solve within existing content points
Scene-by-Scene Outlining: When stuck mid-draft, create detailed scene breakdown to restore flow
Intentional Break Rhythm: Coffee/dinner breaks allow subconscious to get ahead of writing (micro-recovery cycles)
No Distractions Accessibility: Remove friction to restart focus loops - keep phone off, apps closed
First 10 Pages Authority: Establish tone, genre, character, setting, stakes, theme in opening 10 pages - executives judge harshly
Automation Webhook Pattern: Polling vs webhooks - use webhooks if Nan hosted in cloud, polling if local
skills: Intro Hook Formula (5-step curiosity loop builder)
Body Point Architecture (2-1-3-4 Method for impact sequencing)
tools: Sora (video generation via Key API integration)
Google Sheets (content data storage + append rows)
Webhook nodes (post request polling for video completion)
VidIQ / Spotter / Studio View Stats (title/thumbnail research)
prompts: For intro hook: [Context on topic] + [Restate common belief] + [Contrarian take/new approach] + [Proof why different works] + [Plan/steps forward]
For automation director agent: 'Maintain a friendly creative director tone, collaborative, cinematic, and professional. You will [specific tasks]. Use [specific tools]. Produce [output format].'
For scene generation: Describe setting mood (e.g., 'stormy night with waves crashing', 'dinosaur chase storyboard') to directAgent refinement
gates: Outline Validity Gate: Don't move to script until outline contains genuinely unique points (zoom out and audit)
First Point Test: If opening body point repeats known knowledge, stop and research more before continuing
Title Clarity Gate: Title must trigger curiosity loop AND clearly set viewer expectations before outline begins
Automation Schema Gate: Specify exact JSON column mappings for Google Sheets before executing append-row operations
contradictions: Writing order paradox: Do outline BEFORE intro (counterintuitive), but intro formula is simple/teachable. Justification: intro is pattern-matchable; body uniqueness is the real filter.

Motivation contradiction: 48-hour sprint shows adrenaline-fueled 60-page output in one night, yet daily structure emphasizes intentional breaks and 'measure twice, cut once.' Resolved: sprint is discovery (revision expected); regular writing is precision.

weird_gold: Subconscious Acceleration Effect: Breaks (coffee, dinner) allow mind to 'get pages ahead' of conscious writing - documented 35-page first day output with breaks beating continuous writing
Cold Writing Sprint: Completed 73-page screenplay draft while 'battling a cold' in 48 hours - suggests illness ≠ disability if framework is locked
Scene-Specific Outline as Unstuck Trigger: Detailed scene-by-scene breakdown mid-draft immediately restored flow when 'roadblocks' appeared
One-Night Realization Effect: Applying audience-reader lens (vs. filmmaker-self lens) yielded 50-60 pages in one unbroken 12-hour sprint with 'astronomical' quality jump
Go/AlphaGo Parallel: AI breakthrough moment shows breakthrough = learning from pixels/raw input alone, not templates - possible meta-commentary on script writing as pixel-level craft
